limits: second sequence: Central Tottori 2016 (mainshock 2016-10-21 05:07 UTC, Mj 6.6), never used in ARGUS development; the hypotheses were fixed on West Tottori 2026 (21_01/21_02) and are applied here unchanged
one second sequence only

stations are NIED Hi-net (0101) only, chosen as the 50 nearest with data among the current NIED list; the West Tottori 2026 set of 50 stations also included non-Hi-net stations, so station types and geometry differ

waveforms were downloaded around catalogue events only and converted to the West Tottori 2026 h5 form (30-s windows, per-window per-component z-score, JST epoch); whether a filter was applied before the z-score in the 2026 h5 is not recorded (none here; compared in 21_04b G-spec)
the cache was built by 15_01c v3.3 (picking, QC and assembly identical to v3; only the window-index file name and output folder changed)

catalogue: JMA final hypocentres (h2016; West Tottori 2026 used the unified catalogue); past-event locations are JMA hypocentres (in operation: automatic slow-layer locations, possibly worse); truth is also JMA

the 2016 catalogue excludes matched-filter, undetermined/fixed (precision M, 8, 9; flag N, F), artificial and low-frequency events; whether the 2026 catalogue excluded them is not recorded. Manual and automatic hypocentres are mixed (per-flag counts in 21_04a's JSON)
station elevations are NIED's current height(m) (possibly the sensor depth for borehole stations); the 2026 station list's convention is not recorded; static station terms absorb a constant offset
offline PhaseNet picks on full records (possibly better than real-time picks); every method uses the same picks
cache keeps up to 24 stations per event (PhaseNet P first, earliest first); no not-yet-arrived information is used

cache waveforms had the full-window mean removed (includes future samples; removed by the 2 Hz high-pass except for a transient from the window start 3 s before P) and the source h5 is z-score normalised per 30-s window (the scale uses later samples of that window; cosine similarity is scale-invariant except where a window join falls inside the correlation window); the one-sample look-ahead of the cache's central-difference derivative is avoided by not using the last sample
no picking or telemetry latency (tau is ideal elapsed time)
the test events are small (1.5 <= Mj < 2.0); pick quality and station counts can differ from Mj >= 2.0 events
the 2-8 Hz band was chosen after seeing 18_01 on West Tottori 2026
C4's station terms come from past events' JMA hypocentres and truth is also JMA, so part of a C4 gain can be agreement with the JMA frame rather than better early information

C4 corrects only arrived stations held by >= 3 top similar events; each past event's terms are demeaned by its own median P residual over all its stations, while uncorrected stations keep only the static term
21_09: per network, C4 at tau = 2 s vs BEST (alpha 0.005) is the classified test; everything else is descriptive

the sparse networks are subsets of Hi-net stations chosen by a position-only farthest-point rule (N stations, random first station); real sparse networks (ocean-bottom, other station types, other regions) differ

the cache was built on the dense network: events needed >= 4 picks there (some would be missed by a sparse network), and the Wadati S-P quality check used all of an event's stations, so removed stations influenced which S picks of kept stations survive

the cache keeps at most 24 stations per event (measured-P stations ordered by earliest P, then fallback picks); stations beyond the 24th in the full network are unavailable in the thinned network; candidate stations are those appearing in the cache
each network is evaluated on the test events with a P pick at its kept stations, so trends across networks compare different event sets and are descriptive

truth, past-event locations and C4 station terms are JMA hypocentres determined with the dense network; in a region that only has a sparse network the past-event locations would be worse, so C3/C4 here are optimistic
same limits as 21_04 (one sequence, offline PhaseNet picks, no picking or telemetry latency, small events, the 2016 test carries a documented deviation: amendment 03)
